            echo -e "${GREEN}✓ HEALTHY${NC}"

                    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠ WARNING${NC}"
                    echo "  → Port $port is open but not responding to HTTP requests"
                    all_healthy=false
                    return 1
                fi
            fi
            echo -e "${RED}✗ UNHEALTHY${NC}"
            echo "  → Port $port is not responding"
            all_healthy=false

        fi
    elif command -v nc &> /dev/null; then

        echo "  → Neither curl nor nc available for port checking"
        all_healthy=false
        return 1
    fi

        local proc_info=$(lsof -i :"$port" -t 2>/dev/null | head -1)

    fi
